scripts.build: npx turbo build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('apps/backend/.medusa/server/public')){fs.cpSync('apps/backend/.medusa/server/public', 'apps/backend/public', {recursive: true});}"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('apps/backend/public') && fs.existsSync('apps/backend/.medusa/server/public')){fs.cpSync('apps/backend/.medusa/server/public', 'apps/backend/public', {recursive: true});}" && npm run --prefix apps/backend start
